source_en: Home after the late shift at the east side factory. Very productive!
Returning home from the factory. Counted every bolt twice today!
Picking up a new pair of industrial work boots.
Walking home from the factory. Grid is down, so the scenic route!
Checking on the status of the factory power grid.
Evening walk home through the quiet alleys. With my bag, of course.
Going home before curfew. So much tidying up to do!
Factory is shut for good. Going home to my hobbies!
Fulfilling mandatory residency check-in. Happy to be counted!
Going home to my wife and the children for supper.
Back from teaching lessons at School No. 4. Long day.
Collecting my retirement pension from the post office.
Back from my shift at the bread bakery, west side.
Going to my parents' flat. I still live with them.
Home early. Feeling low, I just want to sleep for a week.
Rushing home. I never set foot outside after dark.
Going home to my family. The children are frightened.
Returning from the pensioners' card club at the depot.
Beautiful day for a walk, isn't it? I feel absolutely wonderful!
Just heading back from the factory. Hard work makes for a happy heart.
Why the long face, officer? You should try smiling more. Like me!
Have you noticed how quiet the alleys are getting? It’s perfect for... hobbies.
I found a new tool today. It’s heavy, balanced, and very, very sharp.
Don't look at my eyes. Look at my teeth. They’re much more interesting.
The world is finally matching the inside of my head. I love it!
Can you hear the music? It sounds like everyone screaming at once.
I’m going home to play. There are so many toys left in the dark.
See you tomorrow! I’ll bring you something special. Maybe.
Keep that neck straight, officer. Desk work is awful for your posture.
Thanks, comrade. Keep out of trouble now!
Oh, a private room? How thoughtful of you!
I hope you have strong locks. For your sake, not mine.
You’re just putting me in a box with more toys. Thank you!
Oh! What a surprise! I didn't think you had it in you!
Look at all that red! It’s even prettier than I imagined!
Finally... the big... bright... joke... is over.
A room of my very own? I'll have it redecorated by morning. You'll see.
They always think the lock faces the wrong way. That's what makes it fun.
Tell the other officers I said hello. Or don't. I don't actually care.
You have very steady hands, officer. I have always… admired that…
I’ve been waiting for someone brave enough. Very good. Very good.
My only regret is that I didn’t get to show you… my collection…
Where are you coming from?
The factory, east side! Long shift, very productive. I counted every bolt twice, just for fun.
The alleys behind the factory. Half the grid is down, so I took the scenic route. With my bag, of course.
Everywhere! The curfew keeps everyone indoors, so I have all the empty streets to myself. Wonderful!
The tram depot on the west side! I repair the trams there. Lovely work, very greasy.
Home! My wife and I had a quiet evening in. She sends her regards, officer.
Oh, I'm only visiting! I've never lived here. Just passing through on my way to Batumi!
Are you experiencing any symptoms?
Symptoms? I feel absolutely wonderful! I always do. You should try it sometime, comrade.
I don't sleep much. Too many evening walks! But I have never felt more awake in my life.
My hands ache a little. So much lifting and carrying lately! Otherwise, marvellous!
I've been on sick leave from the factory for a month now. Haven't set foot in the place.
I'm laid up, doctor's orders. I haven't taken a single evening walk in weeks.
I feel terrible, officer. Miserable. I haven't smiled in days. Not once.
You have a very nice neck, officer. Excellent posture. You should be proud.
I love this checkpoint. So many faces. I remember every single one!
Do you keep a list of the people who come through here? I keep my own. Just a hobby!
The alleyways at night are so quiet now, have you noticed? It is wonderful.
You should smile more, officer. Life is very short. Very, very short!
I have been keeping myself very busy lately. Very productive. Very fulfilling.
You are one of the last ones still at your post. I find that admirable. Truly.
The city is almost entirely empty now. So much more room for everyone who remains!
I hope we keep running into each other here, officer. While that is still possible!
